text: Given your history of AIDS, these symptoms strongly suggest an opportunistic infection like cytomegalovirus retinitis. I need to assess your immune status to confirm this suspicion. REQUEST TEST: CD4 Count

speaker: Doctor
text: A CD4 count of 36/mm3 confirms severe immunosuppression, which significantly increases the risk for opportunistic infections like CMV retinitis. I need to visualize the retina directly to confirm the presence of characteristic hemorrhagic lesions. REQUEST IMAGES

text: 34-year-old male. The patient presents with a 2-day history of decreased vision and seeing black spots in the right eye. He reports no pain, and the left eye is asymptomatic. He mentions being treated for fungal esophagitis 6 months ago and was diagnosed with Kaposi's sarcoma 2 years ago.

speaker: Doctor
text: The painless vision loss and floaters in the context of severe immunosuppression are classic for CMV retinitis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis
